camel_example: aliyun eiam SetPasswordHistoryConfiguration --region cn-hangzhou --PasswordHistoryStatus enabled --InstanceId idaas_ue2jvisn35ea5lmthk267xxxxx
description_en: Sets the password history policy for a specified Enterprise Identity and Access Management (EIAM) instance
description_zh: 设置指定EIAM实例下的密码历史策略
kebab_example: aliyun eiam set-password-history-configuration --instance-id idaas_ue2jvisn35ea5lmthk267xxxxx --password-history-status enabled --region cn-hangzhou
name: SetPasswordHistoryConfiguration

parameters.help_en:
The status of the password history configuration. Valid values:
enabled: Enabled.
disabled: Disabled
parameters.help_zh:
密码历史配置状态，取值可选范围：
enabled：开启。
disabled：禁用
parameters.name: password_history_status

parameters.help_en: The number of recent password records to retain. This parameter is required when PasswordHistoryStatus is set to enabled
parameters.help_zh: 保留最近密码记录数。当PasswordHistoryStatus取值为enabled时必传
parameters.name: password_history_max_retention
